          Who Will Be Relegated From the Premier League in 2026-27?
        
      
                          
                      Oct 19, 2026
          
                      Matt Furniss / Author
                  
      
              
                      
                  
          

    
              
      
              
                    
Which teams will be relegated from the Premier League this season? Stay up to date with our live Opta supercomputer predictions for the 2026-27 Premier League relegation battle.
The relegation battle in the 2026-27 Premier League could end up being one of the most exciting in recent seasons.

Across the last three Premier League campaigns, only two promoted sides have avoided relegation. Both of those came last season, however, with Leeds United and Sunderland keeping their place in the English top flight.
The trio of promoted clubs have all started relatively well this time around, with Coventry City, Ipswich Town and Hull City impressing across the opening months of the campaign.

Both Fulham and Bournemouth could find themselves in trouble, while Tottenham's performances over recent seasons won't give their fans huge confidence in not being involved in the relegation scrap once again.
You can keep up with the latest Premier League relegation projections by the Opta supercomputer throughout the 2026-27 season on this page.
